name: Apple Valley Plaza
summary: Apple Valley Plaza is a 17-acre shopping center and movie theatre development in Apple Valley, California. This modern retail destination features comprehensive infrastructure and serves as an important commercial hub for the High Desert community.
demographics: Apple Valley Plaza serves the High Desert community of Apple Valley, which attracts primarily middle-income families and retirees drawn to the area's affordable housing and suburban lifestyle. The trade area encompasses households with moderate income levels, typically ranging from $50,000 to $80,000 annually, with a demographic mix of young families, working professionals, and an established senior population. Shoppers in this market tend to prioritize value and convenience, seeking everyday necessities, family entertainment options like the movie theatre, and accessible retail experiences that serve the practical needs of a growing desert community.
description: Apple Valley Plaza is a 17-acre shopping center and movie theatre development located in the Town of Apple Valley, California. Developed by Apple Valley Plaza, LLC, this modern retail destination was designed with comprehensive infrastructure including advanced water, wastewater, and storm drain systems, along with extensive parking facilities and street improvements. The center features a movie theatre as a key entertainment anchor, providing residents of Apple Valley and the surrounding High Desert communities with convenient access to shopping and entertainment options. The development was engineered with environmental considerations in mind, including a Water Quality Management Plan and Storm Water Pollution Prevention Plan, demonstrating a commitment to sustainable development practices. With its strategic location in Apple Valley and thoughtfully planned layout, the plaza serves as an important commercial hub for the local community.
